scope: Auxiliary rational dynamics and lisse/crystalline admission for the moving Item-269 slope sequence and the actual ordinary-j=2 full two-gate collision

claims.label: PROVED
claims.claim: With Delta_delta=D_(delta+2)-D_delta, the slope is generated by the autonomous rational skew product T(delta,D,Delta)=(delta+2,D+Delta,[P0/P2](delta)Delta).
claims.evidence: P0+P1+P2=0; report equations (1.3)-(1.4) and exact initial states
claims.scope_limit: projective rational degree is at most eight; the counter delta is part of the state

claims.label: PROVED_POSITIVE_RECOGNITION

claims.scope_limit: translation difference is not arithmetic or geometric Frobenius

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_COMPLEXITY
claims.claim: The reduced multiplier of the n-th direct iterate has numerator and denominator degree 4n+3.
claims.evidence: report Section 6; telescoping Q factor, disjoint linear root classes modulo translation by two, and irreducibility of both Q cubics modulo 31
claims.scope_limit: does not obstruct the fixed one-step dynamical system or a different lisse realization

claims.label: EXACT_FINITE_ONLY_OBSTRUCTION_WITNESS

claims.scope_limit: proves existence of singular actual rows but gives no density or weighted-capacity estimate

claims.label: PROVED_SCOPED_RECOGNITION

claims.scope_limit: this is not the complete simultaneous affine gate
